Criterion 1 (interchanges first): the five degree>=3 points are 3, 4, 7, 8, 16, and every one of them sits on the ring or on the O/R spine, so I pinned the ring as a true rectangle and hung everything else off it. Ring rectangle = left col 0 (11 r4, 4 r6, 13 r7, 15 r9), bottom row 4 (11 c0, 6 c4, 7 c5, 14 c8), right col 8 (14 r4, 16 r6, 0 r9), top row 9 (0 c8, 3 c5, 15 c0) -- all 10 ring segments come out H/V. Criterion 3: rows were chosen proportional to real northness (2 -> 0, ring bottom -> 4, O spine -> 6, 13 -> 7, ring top -> 9, 5 -> 14, 1/9 -> 22) and columns proportional to gx, so no east/west or north/south pair is reversed.
